new_defects_found.id: pre-prod #21 ConfigValidator is a dead check
new_defects_found.evidence: tools/checks/pre_prod_check.py:158 tests `(ROOT/'src'/'backend'/'core'/'config'/'validator.py').exists()`. That path does not exist; ConfigValidator was moved to the package `src/backend/core/config/validator/__init__.py:51`. The check therefore always returns the WARN 'ConfigValidator module not found (S17 K-ARCH-1 scaffold)' branch and has never validated anything.
new_defects_found.impact: A CRITICAL-seeming check (waf.strict_required_in_prod) is never executed for the prod profile, so a permissive production WAF would ship undetected. The committed prod.yml is currently correct (waf.strict true, allow_hosts explicit), so there is no live exposure today — the gap is that nothing would catch a regression.

new_defects_found.evidence: tools/checks/startup_time.py:34-35 MAX_STARTUP_SECONDS_PER_MODULE=3.0 and MAX_TOTAL_STARTUP_SECONDS=3.0; pre_prod_check.py:764 wires it as blocking check 19. Observed 2.193s (FAIL) and 2.6s (OK) on the same SHA minutes apart.
